summary: Executed backend + mobile-web frontend regression for iteration 3. Backend passed focused API validation for catalog filters, reels/media byte-range (.webm 200/206/416), booking validation and Mongo persistence, and coupon/order flows (14/14). Frontend core flows largely work: home/header/department strip, reels playback + like/share/copy + add-to-cart, Book It filters + booking confirmation + enquiry history, coupons and checkout tracking. Found reproducible UI/integration gaps around coupon interaction ergonomics and blocked external image asset.

minor.issue: `chip` query parameter is accepted in signature but not used in filtering logic.

ui_bugs.issue: Normal click/tap on `apply-coupon-btn` can be unreliable at some scroll positions due sticky checkout bar overlap; reliable trigger required JS click fallback in automation.
Console shows blocked asset: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1621447504864-d8686f215021?w=400` (`net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB`), causing intermittent broken product imagery.

integration_issues.flow: Cart coupon apply via natural mobile interaction
integration_issues.issue: Coupon application works, but interaction is fragile unless button is fully clear of sticky footer. Can appear as 'no response' to user.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated `props.pointerEvents`; warning suggests migrating to `style.pointerEvents`.
Web console repeatedly logs deprecated `shadow*` style props warning.

action_items: Adjust Cart layout/hit areas so `apply-coupon-btn` is never obscured by sticky checkout bar on mobile web.
Replace ORB-blocked external Unsplash asset(s) with managed `/api/media/*` assets for stable loading.
Implement or remove unused `/api/products?chip=` filter parameter to avoid dead API contract.
Address deprecation warnings (`pointerEvents` prop usage and `shadow*` styles) to reduce future RN-web breakage risk.
critical_code_review_comments: `frontend/app/orders.tsx` swallows API failures (`catch(() => {})`), leaving silent empty-state behavior when request issues occur.
`backend/server.py` includes `chip` arg in products endpoint but never applies it.
`backend/media_store.py` uses fallback integration base URL string; strict env-only fail-fast posture is partially bypassed there.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flows pass; coupon UX + asset loading issue)

seed_data_creation: Created test booking enquiries and test orders during API/UI runs (Mongo persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated at 390x844 and 360 widths; no horizontal overflow detected. Reels video currentTime advanced and strip hidden/restored correctly. Booking flow saved enquiry with reference and history entry. Coupon + checkout path works, but apply interaction can be flaky unless button unobstructed.
rca_of_issue: Coupon tap fragility RCA: sticky checkout footer overlaps coupon action zone in certain scroll positions, so pointer events may route unexpectedly; mitigation is increasing safe bottom spacing above footer and/or moving coupon CTA higher. Image load RCA: direct external Unsplash URL triggers browser ORB block in this environment; mitigation is serving that asset via managed media proxy similar to other catalog assets.
